_comment: Config for scripts/cross-model-review.mjs (the `cross-model review` PR check).
models: the exact model id sent to each vendor. Looked up from the vendor's
own docs on the date in lookedUp; do not guess a newer id, look it up again.
anthropic: https://docs.claude.com (claude-api skill model table), no date suffix.
openai: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models (GPT-6 Astra, the flagship).
xai: https://docs.x.ai/docs/models (Grok 4.6, recommended for code).
authors: email domains that identify a vendor in the commit author email or a
Co-Authored-By trailer, matched case-insensitively on the domain or a
subdomain. ASSUMPTION: Codex trailers use an openai.com address. There is
no Codex commit in this repo's history to verify that against; when the
first one lands, check `git log --format='%(trailers)'` and correct this
list. No code change is needed.
fallback: per reviewer vendor, the vendors to try next when its API fails, in
order. Any vendor that authored the change is removed at run time, so a
mixed Anthropic+OpenAI change reviewed by xAI has no fallback at all and a
vendor outage fails the check rather than passing it silently.
diffCapBytes: `git diff origin/staging...HEAD` larger than this is refused
without a model call.
timeouts: per-request fetch timeouts in ms. vendorMs bounds one model call
(a 150 KB diff at a slow vendor can take minutes); githubMs bounds one
REST call for the sticky comment. The job's timeout-minutes is the
outer bound.
